correctness.rationale: DSIC monotone allocation and the envelope payment equation with type-0 EPIR baseline t_i(0)<=0 yield E total transfers<=E[(sum_i(2V_i−1))q(V)]. Under E q=p and 0<=q<=1, the upper-tail rearrangement of Z_n=sum(2V_i−1) gives the exact maximum R_n(p)=∫_(1−p)^1Q_Z(u)du. The top-Z threshold is monotone in each report and standard zero-baseline envelope transfers attain it, giving exact budget criterion. CLT with Var(Z_n/n^1/2)=1/3 plus uniform L² integrability yields R_n(p)/sqrt(n)→φ(Φ^{-1}(1−p))/sqrt(3). The Gaussian inverse Mills ratio decreases strictly from infinity to zero, giving unique pκ and the claimed limsup/stability on strictly feasible side. Independent Irwin–Hall integrations verified n=1,2 and the Gaussian scaling up to n=100.
residual_risks: No finite-n feasibility claim at the exact limit equality pκ; lower order terms may decide.
